cmc_ww3_Super_Event = {  # super event 127
	hidden_effect = {
		set_temp_variable = { CWIC_se_fire = 127 }
		every_country = {
			limit = { is_ai = no NOT = { has_country_flag = CWIC_se_seen_127 } }
			CWIC_Show_Super_Event = yes
			set_country_flag = CWIC_se_seen_127
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { CWIC_se_opened = 1 } }
				if = { limit = { tag = SOV } play_song = "Super_Event_SOV_World_War_III" }
				else_if = { limit = { tag = RUS } play_song = "Super_Event_SOV_World_War_III" }
				else_if = { limit = { tag = CZE } play_song = "Super_Event_CZE_World_War_III" }
				else_if = { limit = { tag = YUG } play_song = "Super_Event_YUG_World_War_III" }
				else_if = { limit = { tag = FRA } play_song = "Super_Event_FRA_WW3" }
				else = { play_song = "Super_Event_CMC_WW3" }
			}
		}
	}
}

		set_temp_variable = { CWIC_se_fire = 178 }
		every_country = {
			limit = { is_ai = no }
			CWIC_Show_Super_Event = yes
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { CWIC_se_opened = 1 } }
				play_song = "Super_Event_Zyuganov_1997"
			}
		}
	}
}

# Opens the right window for CWIC_se_shown (called by CWIC_Show_Super_Event / CWIC_Reopen_SE_By_Id).
CWIC_Open_SE_Window = {
	clr_country_flag = CWIC_Super_Event_Visible
	clr_country_flag = KOR_Big_Event_Flag
	clr_country_flag = JAP_Big_Event_Flag
	if = { limit = { OR = { check_variable = { CWIC_se_shown = 179 } check_variable = { CWIC_se_shown = 180 } check_variable = { CWIC_se_shown = 181 } check_variable = { CWIC_se_shown = 182 } check_variable = { CWIC_se_shown = 183 } check_variable = { CWIC_se_shown = 184 } check_variable = { CWIC_se_shown = 185 } } } set_country_flag = KOR_Big_Event_Flag }
	else_if = { limit = { OR = { check_variable = { CWIC_se_shown = 186 } check_variable = { CWIC_se_shown = 187 } check_variable = { CWIC_se_shown = 188 } } } set_country_flag = JAP_Big_Event_Flag }
	else = { set_country_flag = CWIC_Super_Event_Visible }
}
